pages.text:
You will have heard he died nine times.

You will have heard the ninth one stuck.

Good. Then I do not have to be tactful.

He was magnificent. I am not being cruel -- he was the best of us and he knew it, which
is the whole trouble. Eight times something killed him, and eight times he came back
and told the story better than it had happened.

The ninth time he went off the harbour wall to prove a point to a man who was not
looking.

I keep his rooms. I keep his notes. I am not going to teach you one single thing he
did. I am going to teach you to notice the moment you stop checking whether you can.

Then somebody keeps your rooms. It is a living.

Go on. Sentry, south gate. Try not to be interesting on the way.
